State provides current application design files, flows and Spanish content (needed for the legacy fallback)

clock_start.basis: Addendum 1, Q3: the 6-month term starts at contract execution, not award. Planned execution is Feb 1, 2027, so delivery runs Feb-Jul 2027.

outstanding_approvals: Kansas written release for the 5 state-owned assets (Legal, Nov 27, 2026)
State notice of intent to award (Jan 15, 2027)
Contract signature by our authorized signatory (Feb 1, 2027)

open_questions.question: Which state approvals sit between award and signature (department, oversight review, funding), and how long does each take?
open_questions.why_it_matters: The documents give only the award and start dates; the chain in between decides whether Feb 1 holds.

open_questions.question: Who is our authorized signatory for this contract?
open_questions.why_it_matters: Needed to schedule the vendor signature before Feb 1.

rad_impacts.note: Finance approved the cost template at checkpoint H4.
Legal approved the fallback positions at checkpoint H5.
With the clock confirmed to start at execution, approval delays move the start date but do not shorten delivery; keep weekly tracking of the award-to-signature chain.
